definitions.explanation: A reflective surface used to see one's image.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}に{映|うつ}った{姿|すがた}
examples.english: The figure reflected in the mirror

examples.japanese: {手鏡|てかがみ}を{持|も}っている。

notes:
{鏡|かがみ} means 'mirror.'

Counter: {枚|まい} (for flat mirrors) or {面|めん} (for round mirrors)

Types:
- {手鏡|てかがみ}: hand mirror
- {姿見|すがたみ}: full-length mirror
- バックミラー: rearview mirror

Cultural note: Mirrors have spiritual significance in Japan - one of the three imperial regalia is a mirror ({八咫鏡|やたのかがみ}).
